properties.description: Chelsea F.C. is an elite professional football club based in Fulham, London, established in 1905. The club competes in the highest tier of English football, the Premier League, and maintains a significant international profile through consistent participation in top-flight European competitions. Known for its deep historical roots and large global fanbase, the club operates a comprehensive ecosystem including a renowned youth academy, a successful women's team, and extensive community outreach programs. It serves as a major cultural anchor in West London while functioning as a global commercial entity.
properties.short_description: Chelsea F.C. is a professional football club based in London, competing in the English Premier League and known for playing home games at Stamford Bridge.
